# Primary-literature review

Updated 21 July 2026.

| Area | Primary sources reviewed | Consequence for positioning |
|---|---|---|
| heat-kernel lattice action | Menotti--Onofri (1981), Manton (1980), Bitar--Duke--Jadid (1985) | action, weak-coupling geometry, and RG motivation are classical |
| compact-group heat kernels | Hall (1994) | spectral and convolution frameworks are classical |
| small-time and logarithmic derivatives | Minakshisundaram--Pleijel (1949), Varadhan (1967), Li--Yau (1986), Chen--Li--Wu (2023) | general local asymptotics and derivative theory predate this work |
| cut-locus asymptotics | Neel--Sacchelli (2025) | the Morse--Bott mechanism is general; this paper gives an explicit SU(2) realization |
| SU(2) explicit analysis | Baudoin--Bonnefont (2009), Agrachev et al. (2009) | nearby explicit results concern subelliptic geometries and different generators |
| two-dimensional Yang--Mills | Gross--King--Sengupta (1989), Sengupta (1993) | exact convolution applications are classical and dimension-specific |
| transfer matrices | Kanwar--Wagman (2021) | establishes current computational relevance without supplying the present bounds |

The search covered exact SU(2) formulas, compact-group derivative estimates,
cut-locus asymptotics, heat-kernel lattice actions, and validated numerical
enclosures.  The manuscript makes no exhaustive priority claim.
